# CSS/DOM conformance — CANVAS ROUND TRIP

*GENERATED by `npx tsx conformance/canvas.ts --write` (or `--report`). Do not
edit — edit the case directories under `conformance/cases/` and re-run.*

The canvas half of the capability matrix, MEASURED: for every case the CSS/DOM
gate declares CARRIED or LOWERED, the captured contract is emitted through the
plugin engine into the mock `figma`, dumped back by the plugin's own dump
script, proposed back by `proposeBatchFromDump` (exact, minting), and compared
to the captured contract on the case's own channel. The v1 bar is idempotence
modulo NAMED walls: a construct that vanishes with nothing naming it is red and
never waivable.

## The numbers

| | |
|---|---|
| cases (CARRIED + LOWERED) | **56** |
| 🟢 round-tripped | **41** |
| 🟢 named (dropped, and a receipt says so) | **14** |
| 🟡 refused by name (the canvas cannot host the seed, and says so) | **1** |
| ⚪ seed-absent (nothing to round-trip) | **0** |
| 🔴 red | **0** — SILENT 0 · DRIFTED 0 · HARMFUL 0 |

Verdicts: **ROUND-TRIPPED** the channel came back with the seed's value (refs
resolved; "ref" says whether the token spelling survived, "as" names a
shorthand/logical sibling the proposer used) · **NAMED** dropped, but the channel
is named in the union of code-only facts, set description, plan notes, mock
step results, dump `_degradations`, proposal notes/unbound, batch notes/skips ·
**REFUSED-BY-NAME** the plan, the mock, or the runtime refused the whole seed by
name · **DRIFTED** a different value came back and nothing named the lowering ·
**HARMFUL** the manifest says no canvas spelling exists and it came back anyway ·
**SILENT** vanished, named by nothing — never waivable.
